Protocol, so an agent's tools stay the same whichever machine the daemon runs on.
A dream pulls the unconsolidated stream, extracts entity, attribute and value claims, writes
them to the cortex and advances a monotonic cursor. Nothing is silently overwritten: a
superseded value stays as audit history, and a competing value with low trust is parked as a
contender instead.
Before a deploy, the update command takes a fresh backup, tags the running image for
rollback, recreates only the daemon container and checks its health. Official efficiency figures,
affluent suffixes and finalised workflows give the shaper ligatures to form: fi, fl, ffi, ffl.
